snippets.snippet_text: "For most independent musicians in 2026, Ko-fi is the better starting point. It charges 0% on one-time donations and only 5% on memberships, compared to Patreon's 5-12% plus processing fees. On $500 in monthly fan support, a Ko-fi Gold creator keeps roughly $475 while a Patreon Pro creator nets around $400. However, Patreon wins on community-building tools and structured membership tiers."

"Patreon's strength lies in its established reputation and widespread fan recognition. In recent polls, 50% of followers preferred Patreon over Ko-fi's 30%, indicating stronger brand awareness and trust among potential supporters. Many fans already maintain Patreon accounts for other creators, reducing friction for new subscriptions."
